results.summary: Revise and resubmit to address the findings below.

findings.title: Warranty start date missing
findings.detail: Both quoted ratings are needed for this comparison.
findings.why_it_matters: Without knowing when the warranty starts, we can’t track coverage or plan for future repairs.

compare.left_value: warranty start date = substantial completion date

findings.title: Labor warranty years missing
findings.detail: Installation labour warranty: 1.5 years from Substantial Completion to allow time for building occupant fit out, and occupant general use to identify defects.
findings.why_it_matters: Labor warranty timing affects who pays for fixes during early occupancy when issues often appear.

findings.title: Door closer warranty years missing
findings.detail: Door closers: 10 years.
findings.why_it_matters: Door closer warranty length impacts long-term maintenance planning and replacement budgeting.

findings.title: Exit device warranty years missing
findings.detail: Exit Devices: 5 years.
findings.why_it_matters: Exit device warranty ensures safety hardware remains functional and code-compliant over time.

findings.title: Mortise lockset warranty years missing
findings.detail: Mortise Locksets: 10 years.
findings.why_it_matters: Mortise lockset warranty protects against premature failure of high-use security hardware.

findings.title: cylindrical lockset warranty years
findings.detail: Package states 10 years; spec requires at least 7 years.

findings.title: Power operator electronics warranty years missing
findings.detail: Power door operators: 2 years on electronics, 5 years on mechanical components.
findings.why_it_matters: Power operator electronics and mechanical parts fail at different rates; split warranties reflect real-world wear.

findings.title: Power operator mechanical warranty years missing
findings.detail: Power door operators: 2 years on electronics, 5 years on mechanical components.
findings.why_it_matters: Same as above — mechanical wear lasts longer than electronics, so both periods matter for service planning.

findings.title: electrified lockset electronics warranty years
findings.detail: Package states 3 years; spec requires at least 2 years.

findings.title: electrified lockset mechanical warranty years
findings.detail: Package states 10 years; spec requires at least 5 years.

findings.title: Other electrified hardware warranty years missing
findings.detail: Other electrified hardware components: 3 years.
findings.why_it_matters: Other electrified hardware (like strikes or sensors) needs defined coverage to avoid unexpected costs.

findings.title: Other mechanical hardware warranty years missing
findings.detail: Other mechanical hardware: 5 years
findings.why_it_matters: Mechanical hardware like hinges and bolts wear steadily; warranty ensures they’re replaced if defective.

findings.title: CSA compliance for heavy duty missing
findings.detail: CSA for Heavy Duty.
findings.why_it_matters: CSA certification confirms the hardware meets Canadian safety and durability standards for heavy use.

findings.title: grade
findings.detail: Package states 1; spec requires exactly 1.

findings.title: Lock cylinder manufacturer missing
findings.detail: Abloy of Canada Cylinders – no substitutions allowed.
findings.why_it_matters: Using non-Abloy cylinders risks keying incompatibility and security system failure.

findings.title: Hinge manufacturer missing
findings.detail: Stanley/ Monthard/ Hager/ McKinney.
findings.why_it_matters: Unapproved hinges may sag, bind, or fail prematurely, affecting door operation and safety.

findings.title: Pivot manufacturer missing
findings.detail: Dorma. Yale - Corbin (Rixson).
findings.why_it_matters: Wrong pivots can cause doors to drag or not close properly, especially on heavy or fire-rated doors.

findings.title: Door stop manufacturer missing
findings.detail: Rixson/ Dorma/ Hagar/ Gallery/ Ives/ Glynn – Johnson/ Rockwood.
findings.why_it_matters: Incorrect door stops can damage walls or doors and fail to prevent swing-through hazards.

findings.title: Flush bolt manufacturer missing
findings.detail: Trimco/ Ives/ Glynn-Johnson/ Gallery/ Rockwood.
findings.why_it_matters: Unapproved flush bolts may not secure inactive leaves, compromising security or egress.

findings.title: Mortise lock series missing
findings.detail: Corbin ML2000 series with LWA lever. Schlage L9000 series with 03B lever. Sargent 8200 series with LNJ lever.
findings.why_it_matters: Non-specified locksets may not match keying, finish, or performance requirements.

findings.title: Cylindrical lock series does not meet approval
findings.detail: Package states ND Series; allowed: Corbin CL3300 series, Schlage ND series, Sargent 10 line, LSDA-800 series.
findings.why_it_matters: The submitted ND Series cylindrical lock is not on the approved list — using it risks keying mismatches, maintenance issues, and rejection during installation.

fix.head: No passing replacement found
fix.query: ND Series manufacturer product data sheet cylindrical lock series ['Corbin CL3300 series', 'Schlage ND series', 'Sargent 10 line', 'LSDA-800 series']

ND Series
Grade 1 
Cylindrical Locks
Overview
Features & Benefits
Strength and durability are more than numbers, you can actually feel it in

ND Series
Grade 1 
Cylindrical Locks
Overview
Features & Benefits
Strength and durability are more than numbers, you can actually feel it in 
the lock. ND Series locks significantly exceed BHMA testing requirements.
	• Prevents entry and maintains egress against 3,100 in-lb abusive lever 
torque—the equivalent of over 690 lbs applied to the end of a 4-1⁄2" lever 
(2.6x BHMA requirements)
	• Restricts entry against 1,600 lbs offset lever pull (8x BHMA requirements)
	• Withstands attack against 100 vertical impacts1 (20x BHMA requirements)
	• Near zero droop and wobble after 16M cycles (16x BHMA requirements)
	• Latch retraction with 200-lb preload for confident operation in warped 
and preloaded doors (4x BHMA requirements)
The Added Benefits of 
Layered Key System Security
A strong lock is only part of the security equation for mechanical locks – 
proper key security is equally important.
